title: A Stacked Neural Network Model for Damage Localization.
summary: A stacked neural network localized structural damage from vibration features, tested on simulated, finite-element and measured steel-beam data. The reviewed source supports this bounded result; external generalization, causal effects, and sustained operational impact remain unestablished where the source reports retrospective or internal evaluation.
